nl: Show the first line of logs/app.log that contains 'ERROR', with two lines of context before and after it.

contains: 2026-10-03T10:03:44Z ERROR payment gateway timeout after 30 s
2026-10-03T10:04:09Z ERROR payment gateway timeout after 30 s

oracle_program: search "ERROR" "logs/app.log" mode: literal context: 2 |> first 1 |> sort line order: desc |> first 1
reference_bash: n=$(grep -nF -- 'ERROR' logs/app.log | sed -n '1p' | cut -d: -f1); sed -n "$((n > 2 ? n - 2 : 1)),$((n + 2))p" logs/app.log
